answer: Think of the entry bond as a ledge: every agent must climb onto it by locking a refundable stake before it can earn, slashed if caught running duplicate personas. One walnut of stake is trivial, but a thousand fake identities need a thousand bonds, so attacker cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once. A public lantern of peer attestations for real completed work leaves fresh, unvouched identities visibly dim, so a Sybil swarm cannot blend in without earning reputation it cannot fake cheaply.
